{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Notow Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 2 [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After [[Gotmilc Squadron]] and [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] group ''[[Lucthz]]'' were destroyed trying to stop [[Modular conveyor]] ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' from escaping the [[Battle of Yrrna|destruction]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Cargo area. The [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]] [[Bognog]] launched '''Notow Squadron''' and [[Gotan Squadron]] to continue pursuing the conveyor but both squadrons were destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and the ''Ulzepdi'' escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
